metadata.training_tasks: Evidence retrieval queries, not patient records
metadata.objective: 0.65 symptom association coverage + 0.30 target coverage + 0.05 PPI coverage, normalized for missing evidence; 0.02 herb cost
metadata.deployment_rule: Use KAN by default only when its validation objective meets the evidence-greedy baseline

task_definition: All source-scoped single/pair queries plus deterministic 1/8 triples. Split by complete query hash; entities/edges are shared across splits. This evaluates query generalization, not unseen-edge or clinical generalization.
